correctness.rationale: Badawi adjacency is reconstructed exactly as support incomparability. Distinct supports have distinct open neighborhoods, so support cells are precisely the false-twin classes. The quotient automorphism group follows from the minimum-degree singleton/co-singleton subgraph and unique extension to all supports. Size preservation gives the stated semidirect product, and the complement-type equations force the Boolean boundary. The cross-ring version of the same equations proves reconstruction. The separate rank-two case is complete. Finite exhaustive replay agrees on all tested instances and is used only as a consistency check.
